known_before_run: The Stage A result and its descriptive diagonal-curvature estimate (an estimate with sign and size not established: flow_24 gains near +3e-5 to +5e-5 N at the middle fractions and about +2e-5 N at the full step, a marginal toss-up against the 3e-5 N floor; flow_32 drag estimates at or below the 3e-5 N jitter floor at small steps), the LOWDIM-03 ladder and all earlier results were visible; this is not blind validation.
prohibitions: no second iteration, curvature model, basis expansion, reinitialization or further step beyond this ladder
no automatic resubmission or repair after a terminal/integrity failure
an ACCEPT is a bounded capability result, not an optimizer qualification and not a go-ahead

rules.accept: strictly more than 3e-5 N downforce gain and a computed drag change <= 0 on BOTH grids, plus the five geometry gates (LOWDIM-03 rule, unchanged)
rules.incomplete: any integrity failure, one grid incomplete, a non-finite run: no analysis is written
rules.parent_gate: fresh parent CSVs must be byte-identical to the retained LOWDIM-03 s1.25 mm runs before any other state runs
rules.selection: largest minimum actual downforce gain over both grids among the accepted positive steps; exact ties choose the smaller step
